verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no bulk import capability for customers or transactions, and nothing on tracking import job status or resuming after a partial failure. The Events API is per-event real-time submission, webhook retry with backoff covers outbound delivery rather than inbound imports, and scheduled Portfolio workflows are not bulk loads, so none of these count toward this story.

support.subject: As a developer, I can track bulk customer and transaction imports and resume after partial failure
